week.headline: The NFELO model and Vegas are 10.9 percentage points apart on the Rams at Arizona.

rest.headline: Buffalo projects to 13.7 wins, the most in the league.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: Cleveland's playoff chances rose the most this week, to 56%. Buffalo is the Super Bowl favorite at 15%.
